title: Three-Payment Settlement Opening Payment Size and the Call Acceptance Window
content:
# Three-Payment Settlement — Opening-Payment Shortening

**Rule.** When a consumer accepts a Three-Payment Settlement offer of Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements on a recorded call, the Three-Payment opening payment is the offer's settlement amount times 33.0 percent; where that opening payment is under 300.00 dollars the Three-Payment call window is shortened by 2 days; where it is at least 300.00 dollars but under 600.00 dollars, by 1 day; an opening payment of 600.00 dollars or more takes no opening-payment shortening.

The settlement amount is the one written on the open Three-Payment offer being accepted.

## Ladder

| Opening payment (33.0 percent of the offer's settlement amount) | Shortening of the call window |
|---|---|
| under 300.00 dollars | 2 days |
| 300.00 dollars up to 599.99 dollars | 1 day |
| 600.00 dollars or more | none |

## Worked hypothetical figures

| Offer's settlement amount | Opening payment | Shortening |
|---|---|---|
| 900.00 dollars | 297.00 dollars | 2 days |
| 1000.00 dollars | 330.00 dollars | 1 day |
| 1818.00 dollars | 599.94 dollars | 1 day |
| 1820.00 dollars | 600.60 dollars | none |

The opening payment is compared unrounded: 599.94 dollars is under 600.00 dollars.
